_comment: Hive's replay camera angles for the demo videos (recording/README.md). Every script in recording/ reads this file. Positions are metres. 'offset' is in the followed model's frame (x forward, y left, z up from the model origin). Fixed positions are Gazebo world ENU: x east, y north, z up (world NED north = y, east = x). Drone entity names are <model>_<id>: in scenarios/surveillance.yaml the defenders are x500_gimbal_1..3 (left to right on the arc, 150 m north of the base at 40 m) and the hostile is x500_4. Check with `docker exec px4-gazebo-vnc gz model --list` during a run.
_live_comment: Live cameras (mount-backend.sh camrec, swarm_backend/ui/camera_video.py) use the same angles. Differences from the replay: a follow angle with look_at_model puts its offset in the frame of the line from the followed drone to the looked-at one (x = towards it), so the camera stays behind the drone as seen from the target; '@attacker' follows whichever of 'defenders' is nearest 'hostile'. A model moved to graveyard_enu (the hostile at a hit, gazebo_surveillance.GRAVEYARD_ENU) is held where it was, so the cameras stay on the hit.
